user.title: Set up Hearth
user.description: Hearth adds a family board to your dashboards. After setup, use Configure to add your family members and pick the calendars and lists that belong to each of them.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Hearth is already set up. Use Configure on the existing entry to change your family.

data_description.color: Used for this person's events and highlights across every Hearth card.
data_description.person: Links presence to this member. Optional.
data_description.calendars: Calendars whose events belong to this member.
data_description.todo_lists: Lists counted as this member's open tasks.
data_description.points_entity: A sensor whose state is a points balance, for example a Chores4Kids child sensor. Optional.
data_description.avatar: Path to an image, for example /local/hearth/ben.png. Optional.

routines.title: Choose a routine
routines.description: Pick the family member and the time of day. The next step is where the steps per weekday go.

routine_steps.title: {name} – {block}
routine_steps.description:
One step per line. Empty days have no routine.

The school timetable is not read from anywhere — it is fixed for a school year. Just put "pack PE kit" on the days that have PE.

abort.member_not_found: That family member no longer exists.

set_routine_step.name: Set routine step
set_routine_step.description: Tick a routine step off for today, or put it back.

step.name: Step
step.description: The step, exactly as configured in the routine.

done.name: Done
done.description: True ticks it off, false puts it back.

reset_routine.name: Reset routine
reset_routine.description: Clears today's ticks, for one member or for everyone.
